review_text: This is app world worst digital wallet app. I doesn't suggest anyone to download this one. I always give you zero rating esewa. Nepal ko chor app rahexa yaar. 100Rs. bank ma transfer garda 10 charge chahinxa re kahabata aauxa esewa ko baule dinxa. Client lai. But khalti ma 1k sama transfer garayo vane zero charge linxa. Kun business idea ho yo aru bata ta kehi sekhos esewa company. Nepal ko chor app.
